target: For q>0,L>=1, F integer polynomial system with e equations in m solved+k parameter variables, actual lower root x, and actual solved Jacobian J modq surjective, construct an integer tower z_n starting at x for EVERY supplied compatible integer parameter path t_n with t_0=freePart x and q^(L+n) dividing t_(n+1)-t_n. Require freePart z_n=t_n exactly, polynomial root depth L+n, full vector compatibility, and constant actual solved Jacobian. For prime p and any arbitrary p-adic target tau congruent to freePart x modp^L, construct a parameter path and the tower, prove convergence to b with F(b)=0 and freePart b=tau, retain b-z_n depth L+n, and prove exactly p^(m-e) residue lifts at each stage for every next parameter digit.
square_case: When m=e, exact roots in the base ball with the same prescribed p-adic parameters are unique, hence all constructed path/tower choices converge to the same root. Do not claim uniqueness for m>e.
completion: Actual polynomial construction under only initial solved-block surjectivity; parameter path existence from arbitrary p-adic target; exact parameter equality at integer levels and at the limit; fresh Lean gate and independent raw proof audit. Assuming a compatible full solution tower or assuming per-step solvability is only partial.
primary_route: Exact prescribed integer step plus dependent induction and actual p-adic tower limit.
alternative_route: Append parameter coordinates to F, prove augmented surjectivity for rectangular solved block, and use existing local map/tower results with moving parameter targets.
boundary: Full Jacobian surjectivity alone need not permit every parameter digit; solved-block surjectivity suffices and is stronger. Rectangular solved blocks can leave positive-dimensional fibers.
deferred: General singular persistence without solved-block surjectivity, analyticity, native presentation invariance/descent, parameterized tower homeomorphisms beyond existing chart interfaces.
